subject: USE statement
notes: CLOSED 2026-09-09 by the PB365/PB366 reconciliation - the row carried TWO measured defects, each mechanism owned one, and this is the first tree on which both cures exist together. Rule text (cite.py --check 14.9.49.4 'A declarative is selected for execution by analyzing the USE statements in a source element in the order in which they are specified' -> OK GR 14; 'is a factory object or instance object of object-class-name-1 or of a subclass of object-class-name-1' -> OK GR 14 a); 'all of the USE statements in the source element are analyzed again' -> OK GR 14 a) (its otherwise-clause); 'described with an IMPLEMENTS clause that references interface-name-1' -> OK GR 14 b)). || DEFECT 1, GR14 a)'s FACTORY arm, FIXED by kb/Work PB366: the factory object of class X is a distinct emitted type X__FACTORY deriving from the BASE class's factory (OoEmitter.EmitClassUnit / OoClassSymbol.FactoryCsName), never from X, so the selector's single `__obj is X` test was false for every factory exception object - silently, no declarative and no diagnostic. Measured before (probe: `01 FR USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE.` / `SET FR TO CF1.` / `RAISE FR.` against `USE AFTER EXCEPTION OBJECT CF1`) -> `AFTER` alone where the spec requires `F4-HANDLER / AFTER`; the instance control reached the handler. The cure is the census OoClassSymbol.FactoryOrInstanceCsTypes rendered as one C# or-pattern per entry, `__obj is X or X__FACTORY`; 'or of a subclass' rides C#'s `is` in EACH hierarchy because both mirror INHERITS. Witness conformance:cases/14.9.49-USE/pb366_use_exception_object_factory walks five arms - an exact-class factory, a factory two declaratives match (source-order first-match plus 'no other declaratives are executed'), a SUBCLASS factory naming no declarative of its own, an INSTANCE object, and an unmatched factory falling to the 14.6.13.1.5 tail - and on the pre-fix tree arms 1, 2 and 3 printed no handler at all. || DEFECT 2, GR14 b) absent, FIXED by kb/Work PB365: an interface operand was rejected at bind with COBOL0859 (SR16's diagnostic answering SR17's question) and there was no second analysis pass over the USE statements at all. The selector is now TWO passes - EmitObjDispatchPass emits every object-class-name-1 entry in source order, then, only after all of them, every interface-name-1 entry - which is what 'otherwise, all of the USE statements in the source element are analyzed again and: b) ...' requires and which an interleaved single pass cannot express (an earlier interface entry would beat a later class entry). GR14 b)'s 'described with an IMPLEMENTS clause' is 11.8.4 GR2 (instance objects) / 11.4.4 GR2 (factory objects) as a CLOSURE - own IMPLEMENTS, an implemented interface's INHERITS, an inherited class's IMPLEMENTS - and the emitter renders each emitted HALF of a class with exactly that closure as its C# interface list, so one test against OoInterfaceSymbol.ImplementedCsTypes realises all three legs for both object kinds. Witness conformance:cases/14.9.49-USE/pb365_use_eo_interface_two_pass, whose interface declarative is written FIRST and whose expected output (CLASS-CY, AFTER-1, IFACE, AFTER-2) is produced only by a selector that honours the pass boundary. || THE RECONCILED SHAPE (this change set): BoundDeclarative.Eo is the discriminated BoundEoOperand - BoundEoClass(OoClassSymbol) | BoundEoInterface(OoInterfaceSymbol) - carrying the RESOLVED SYMBOL, never a rendered C# type name, and each GR14 pass renders its own alternative's census. Both goldens were re-measured on the merged tree and match their .out byte-for-byte. pb366_use_exception_object_factory itself needed repair, not exemption: two of its class definitions inherited from PBFBASE with no REPOSITORY paragraph, which 11.3.3 SR2 forbids and PB365's 8.4.6.4 funnel now enforces. Format4UseObjectSelectorDriftTests asserts against the GENERATED C# that each alternative's census equals what the backend actually emits, that the selector tests every member, and that the class pass precedes the interface pass; both new detectors were fired against a deliberately broken census and a deliberately swapped pass order before being trusted. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 2002/2014/2023 (FORMAT 4 - the exception-object / OO facility). No Annex E entry touches it.
